title: Some results on the distance spectral radius and edge-disjoint spanning trees of graphs
summary: Let $τ(G)$ denote the maximum number of edge-disjoint spanning trees in a connected graph $G$ of order $n$, and let $ρ_D(G)$ denote its distance spectral radius. For an integer $k\ge2$, Fan, He and Zhao [Discrete Appl. Math. 376 (2025) 31--40] obtained a sharp distance spectral radius condition for $τ(G)\ge k$ when $n\ge2k+6$. In this paper, we fill the gap $2k\le n\le2k+5$ and thus complete the result for all $n\ge2k$.
